name: vona
description: Vona is an intuitive, elegant and powerful Node.js framework for rapidly developing enterprise applications of any size
author: zhennann

scripts.db:reset: npm run prerun && npm run vona :bin:dbReset -- --flavor=normal
scripts.dev: npm run prerun && npm run vona :bin:dev -- --workers=2 --flavor=normal
scripts.dev:one: npm run prerun && npm run vona :bin:dev -- --workers=1 --flavor=normal
scripts.tsc:native: npm run prerun && node ../scripts/typecheck.ts native vona --noEmit --incremental false --project tsconfig.json
scripts.tsc:legacy: npm run prerun && node ../scripts/typecheck.ts typescript vona --noEmit --incremental false --project tsconfig.json
scripts.build: npm run prerun && npm run vona :bin:build -- --flavor=normal
scripts.build:docker: npm run prerun && npm run vona :bin:build -- --flavor=docker
